models.curator: agent-own (wiki model unset: each answer model curates its own concepts)

billing.plan: Ollama Cloud Pro ($60 included a month, 3 concurrent requests)

interruptions: 429s, closed usage windows (waited out from /api/balance's resets_at), quota windows, daily caps, empty replies, timeouts and dropped sockets are re-run from the job's answer/judge checkpoints after a cooldown and never count against its attempts; a question that errors fails the job (--strict-questions) instead of being scored; only a classified permanent refusal stops a job, which is then reported incomplete, never as wrong answers
sharedIngest: LongMemEval-M and BEAM-1M write sides are built once per write-side configuration (no model call) and seeded into every read-side arm
